# Gengchou v2.4.2

v2.4.2 is a reliability and release-governance update. It keeps the existing
provider, settings, cache, executable, and update identities unchanged.

## Changes

- Stop treating a WSL probe that cannot start, times out, or exits unexpectedly
  as proof that Claude authentication failed. Those cases now use the normal
  transient request-failure path and never raise an authentication warning.
  A concrete credential file that is unreadable or otherwise unusable still
  uses **Authentication failed**, preserving the single sign-in recovery users
  already know.
- Rotate diagnostics while Gengchou is running instead of waiting for the next
  launch. Every write follows the current `diagnose.log` pathname, cooperating
  processes are serialized, and only the current log plus one `.old` generation
  are retained.
- Serialize settings and usage-cache persistence independently and attach a
  monotonic revision to each snapshot, so a slow older write cannot overwrite
  newer state. Temporary files are flushed and synced before replacement.
- Limit every provider and updater JSON response body to 4 MiB before parsing,
  preventing a broken endpoint from growing this long-running process without
  bound.
- Make invalid theme-color input fall back safely instead of panicking, and
  remove several stale wrappers, parameters, and the last production `unwrap`.
- Record the historical v2.3.2-v2.4.0 ancestry discontinuity without moving any
  published tag, add tracked repository invariants, and make future releases
  verify that the preceding official tag is an ancestor.

## Updating

No settings or cache migration is required. Users of v2.4.1 can update normally
or replace the existing executable with `gengchou.exe` and start it again.

Do not update an installation older than v2.2.4 directly to this release. The
v2.2.4 release remains available as the required bridge.
